# hbonboard

Member onboarding service for Hanbit Pay. People sign up in the app, on the
web or through a partner; a new member stays `pending` until the identity
check comes back. The identity-check run sends new members to the identity
vendor through its CLI (`vendor/bin/idchk`, delivered as a binary by the
vendor), reads each member's verdict back and activates or rejects the
member. Members get a text message with the result, and the admin console
shows the onboarding backlog.

```
hbonboard/
  app.py            wiring (build_app) and the tiny router
  api/              request/response helpers and endpoint handlers
  services/         sign-up, identity-check run, notices, admin backlog
  kyc/              vendor request lines, verdict mapping, CLI wrapper
  store/            in-memory member repository
  util/             phone, names, dates, cache
vendor/bin/         vendor identity-check CLI (idchk --help)
tests/              unit tests and end-to-end API tests
```

The CLI keeps its working files under `$IDCHK_HOME` (tests use a temp dir).
Run all tests with `bash test.sh`.

"""Contract checks against the vendor CLI binary shipped in vendor/bin."""
import unittest

from hbonboard.config import DEFAULTS
from hbonboard.kyc.client import IdchkClient
from hbonboard.models import KycRequest, VendorError
from tests.support import VendorHome


class IdchkClientTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.home = VendorHome()
        self.client = IdchkClient(DEFAULTS.with_overrides(idchk_home=self.home.path))

    def tearDown(self):
        self.home.cleanup()

    def test_submit_then_result_roundtrip(self):
        ticket = self.client.submit([
            KycRequest("T-1", "홍길동", "19900101", "01011112222"),
            KycRequest("T-2", "Kim Ara", "19851231", "01033334444"),
            KycRequest("T-3", "이도", "20000229", "0162223333"),
        ])
        self.assertTrue(ticket.job_id.startswith("J"))
        self.assertEqual(ticket.lines, 3)
        for ref in ("T-1", "T-2", "T-3"):
            self.assertIn(self.client.result(ref), (1, 2))
        self.assertEqual(self.client.job(ticket.job_id)["in"], "3")

    def test_unknown_reference_has_no_result(self):
        self.assertIsNone(self.client.result("T-404"))

    def test_malformed_line_rejects_the_file(self):
        with self.assertRaises(VendorError) as ctx:
            self.client.submit([KycRequest("T-1", "홍길동", "19900101", "021234567")])
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, "E17")
        self.assertIsNone(self.client.result("T-1"))

"""End-to-end: sign-up -> identity-check run -> member status, notices, admin backlog."""
import unittest

from tests.support import VendorHome, app_with_members, load_signups

# sandbox personas whose details the vendor reports as not matching
SANDBOX_MISMATCH = {"김하늘", "오지훈", "임하린", "황보 현"}


class OnboardingRunTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.home = VendorHome()
        self.signups = load_signups()
        self.app, self.ids = app_with_members(self.home, self.signups)
        # noise: a second sign-up with an already registered phone is refused
        dup = dict(self.signups[3], name="최민준", phone="010 5502 9913")
        self.assertEqual(self.app.post("/members", dup).status, 409)
        self.run = self.app.post("/kyc/run")

    def tearDown(self):
        self.home.cleanup()

    def member(self, member_id):
        resp = self.app.get(f"/members/{member_id}")
        self.assertEqual(resp.status, 200, resp.body)
        return resp.body

    def test_run_sends_every_new_member(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.run.status, 200, self.run.body)
        self.assertEqual(self.run.body["sent"], len(self.signups))
        self.assertTrue(self.run.body["jobs"])

    def test_no_member_is_left_waiting_after_the_run(self):
        waiting = [i for i in self.ids if self.member(i)["status"] == "pending"]
        self.assertEqual(waiting, [], "new members are still waiting for the identity check")

    def test_decisions_follow_the_identity_check(self):
        for member_id, payload in zip(self.ids, self.signups):
            body = self.member(member_id)
            expected = "rejected" if body["name"] in SANDBOX_MISMATCH else "active"
            self.assertEqual(body["status"], expected, f"{member_id} {payload['name']}")

    def test_backlog_report_is_empty(self):
        report = self.app.get("/reports/kyc-backlog").body
        self.assertEqual(report["total"], len(self.signups))
        self.assertEqual(report["counts"]["pending"], 0, "admin backlog still lists pending members")
        self.assertEqual(report["pending"], [])

    def test_every_member_gets_exactly_one_notice(self):
        messages = self.app.get("/outbox").body["items"]
        self.assertEqual(sorted(m["member"] for m in messages), sorted(self.ids),
                         "some members never got a sign-up result message")

    def test_next_run_has_nothing_new_to_send(self):
        again = self.app.post("/kyc/run").body
        self.assertEqual(again["sent"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(again["jobs"], [])

    def test_member_detail_masks_phone(self):
        body = self.member(self.ids[0])
        self.assertEqual(body["phone"], "010-****-7730")
        self.assertEqual(body["channel"], "app")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

        self.run = self.app.post("/kyc/run")

        self.assertEqual(resp.status, 200, resp.body)
        return resp.body

        self.assertEqual(self.run.body["sent"], len(self.signups))
        self.assertTrue(self.run.body["jobs"])

        for member_id, payload in zip(self.ids, self.signups):
            body = self.member(member_id)
            expected = "rejected" if body["name"] in SANDBOX_MISMATCH else "active"
            self.assertEqual(body["status"], expected, f"{member_id} {payload['name']}")

        self.assertEqual(report["total"], len(self.signups))

        self.assertEqual(body["channel"], "app")

from hbonboard.kyc.requests import build_batch
from hbonboard.kyc.verdicts import apply_verdict

        self.repo = repo
        self.client = client
        self.settings = settings
        self.today = today
        self.notifier = notifier
        self.on_resolved = on_resolved

        fresh = sorted(self.repo.by_kyc_state(KYC_NEW), key=lambda m: m.member_id)
        if not fresh:
            return [], 0
        by_id = {m.member_id: m for m in fresh}
        requests = build_batch(fresh)
        size = self.settings.idchk_batch_lines
        jobs = []
        for start in range(0, len(requests), size):
            chunk = requests[start:start + size]
            ticket = self.client.submit(chunk)
            jobs.append(ticket.job_id)
            for request in chunk:
                member = by_id[request.ref]
                member.kyc_state = KYC_SENT
                member.kyc_job = ticket.job_id
                member.history.append(KYC_SENT)
        return jobs, len(fresh)

        for member in sorted(self.repo.by_kyc_state(KYC_SENT), key=lambda m: m.member_id):
            code = self.client.result(member.member_id)
            if code is None:
                # the vendor has not answered for this one yet; ask again next run
                waiting.append(member.member_id)
                continue
            apply_verdict(member, code)

            if self.notifier:
                self.notifier.verdict(member)
            resolved.append({"id": member.member_id, "status": member.status})

        resolved, waiting = self._collect()
        if resolved and self.on_resolved:
            self.on_resolved()
        return {"jobs": jobs, "sent": sent, "resolved": resolved, "waiting": len(waiting)}
